criteria.statement: Kind 30316 transcript events are published with session, turn, role, sequence, envelope, and service-held key metadata tags.
Kind 30316 content is a service-held symmetric-key AEAD envelope and does not expose plaintext transcript text.
Replay uses scoped EOSE subscription semantics, dedupes relay duplicates by event id, decrypts payloads, and returns chronological multi-turn history by sequence.
Replay truncation keeps the most recent messages while preserving chronological order.
A fresh store/session with the same service-held key can decrypt and rebuild history without per-recipient sealing state.
Context building exposes replay-backed provider-neutral model history and does not use legacy TranscriptSummary when a transcript provider is configured.
